title: A more connected path from discovery to participation.
intro: The design work brought discovery, conversation and subsequent features into a shared Web experience: clearer ways to find a character, a more focused conversation space, and more control over how to take part.

The strongest thread through this work is user agency. A scenario suggests where to begin. A reply offers a possible next line. A persona describes a role. In each case, the experience is stronger when the user can still choose, adjust and continue.

items.label: DISCOVERY
items.title: Can people find a fit?
body: I would evaluate time to a first suitable conversation and the paths people take from recommendations, scenarios and search.

items.label: PARTICIPATION
items.title: Does assistance help them respond?
body: I would examine whether suggested replies lead to a message, how often people edit them, and where generation or cancellation interrupts the flow.

items.label: CONNECTION
items.title: Do they want to continue?
body: I would pair return-to-chat behavior with qualitative feedback on immersion, personal relevance and emotional connection.
The work shown here is the product design and interaction specification. The questions above describe how I would evaluate its effectiveness beyond the design deliverables.
